oracle: a suggestion is drawn only where its quote resolves exactly; one that does not is listed as stale (A7.8)
what: the annotation layer resolves pending suggestions with the fuzzy comment resolver (position fallback), so a draft-only quote is drawn on the published version instead of being stale

target.case: A7.8 a suggestion quoting text only the draft holds is drawn for the editor reading the draft and listed as stale, undrawn, for a reader of the published version

expect.message: the reader's panel calls it stale
